Carmen L.: Hey @people-ops — spotted an issue on my 9/30 paycheck. RSU withholding was taken at CA rate even though I moved to OR on 2024-09-15. Net pay is much lower than I expected, can someone check?
Sophia (People Ops): @Carmen L. sorry to see that. Can you paste the paystub snippet or confirm EmpID + last4 so payroll can pull the run?
Carmen L.: EmpID 6721, last4 4321. Pasted snippet below — copied exactly from PDF:
```
Payrun: 2024-09-30
EmpID: 6721
Move date on file: 2024-09-15
RSU withholding line: State tax (CA) 6.60% $1,980.00
Net pay: $1,120.45
```
Payroll Bot: Ticket created: PAY-1349 assigned to @Henry (Payroll). ETA: initial review in 1 business day.
Henry (Payroll): I pulled run 20240930 batch-2. Jurisdiction shown = CA Standard (CA-STD). Looks like the state change was entered in HR but didn’t sync to payroll before the cut.
Henry (Payroll): Plan: 1) reverse the RSU withholding adjustment in a reversal batch (will return withheld CA state tax) 2) process an off-cycle payroll to withhold OR appropriate amount or issue refund if overwithheld 3) document for W-2 impact.
Marc (Legal): FYI — if CA taxes were actually remitted already for Q3, we may need a W-2c for state boxes after we correct. Confirm with tax team before committing to W-2 plan.
Tax Team: Quick note — CA refund process can take weeks; easiest for employee experience is payroll credit in the off-cycle while we file for state reclaim. If the employee prefers to claim on personal return, we can provide docs.
Henry (Payroll): Estimated timeline: reversal submitted within 3 business days, off-cycle payroll processed within 7–10 business days after reversal posts. If remediation requires W-2c, we’ll prepare after year-end reconciliation (or sooner if CA demands).
Sophia (People Ops): Action items: 
• @Henry start reversal and off-cycle plan (PAY-1349)
• @Tax Team confirm whether we should payroll-credit or wait for state refund
• @Marc flag W-2c trigger conditions
I’ll keep Carmen looped.
Carmen L.: Thank you — appreciate the quick response. Please cc me once the off-cycle is scheduled. :pray:
Henry (Payroll): Will do. I’ll post updates in this thread and in PAY-1349. :thumbsup:
Carmen L.: Got it, thanks everyone.
